svg.title: Animation of the eight steps of a QR sign-in: the phone scans the QR code, opens a tunnel, announces itself over Bluetooth, the browser and the phone exchange a handshake through the tunnel, the browser asks for a signature, you approve on the phone, and the phone sends the signature, after which the browser is signed in.

g.text: Tell the browser where to go
The browser asks for a signature
On the phone · fingerprint, face or PIN
